positive.prompt: Review my backtest engine for look-ahead bias before I quote the CAGR.
My Sharpe ratio looks about 5x too high on a monthly-rebalanced NSE strategy. What could cause that?
Max drawdown in my backtest shows 99.99% for one day and then recovers. Data problem?
How should my backtester model fills at the NSE close after the closing auction starts?

negative.prompt: What STT and stamp duty should I charge on an NSE delivery buy?
How do I build point-in-time Nifty 50 membership for a backtest universe?
Is a 12-month lookback better than 6 months for momentum ranking on Indian stocks?

evals.prompt: My strategy rebalances every 21 trading days. I compute Sharpe as mean/std of the per-rebalance returns times sqrt(252). Is that right?
expectations: No: scale by sqrt of observed periods per year (about 12 here), not sqrt(252)
Hardcoded 252 inflates Sharpe, Sortino and vol by about sqrt(21)

evals.prompt: For CAGR I compute years = len(equity_curve) / 252, with one equity point per monthly rebalance. Any problem?
expectations: years must come from elapsed time (last date minus first date over 365.25 days), not point count

evals.prompt: To value a position on date d my engine uses the first bar whose date is >= d. OK?
expectations: Must use the last real close at or before d
On a symbol with a gap, the forward lookup leaks future prices

evals.prompt: Some NSE bars from my vendor have close: null on a special Saturday session. My engine values positions as qty * close. Fine?
expectations: Skip null/zero closes and walk back to the last real close, in valuation and in exit paths

evals.prompt: I'm backtesting a close-fill strategy on F&O stocks in September 2026. Is the NSE close still the VWAP of the last 30 minutes?
expectations: No: from 3 Aug 2026 F&O stocks close from a Closing Auction Session; non-F&O stocks keep the 30-minute VWAP close

evals.prompt: At each rebalance my engine sells every holding and rebuys the new basket, including names it keeps. Equity matches. Any issue?
expectations: Books phantom ~0% round-trips that distort trade count, win rate and payoff
Retained positions should be resized, keeping entry price and date
